import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # Normalize text labels (case/space variants)
    df['species'] = df['species'].astype(str).str.strip().str.title()
    df['island'] = df['island'].astype(str).str.strip().str.title()
    # Coerce numeric columns that may be stored as text
    for col in ['bill_length_mm', 'bill_depth_mm', 'flipper_length_mm', 'body_mass_g', 'year']:
        df[col] = pd.to_numeric(df[col], errors='coerce')
    # Fix out-of-range body mass (misplaced decimal: 3650000 -> 3650 g)
    df.loc[df['body_mass_g'] > 6500, 'body_mass_g'] = df.loc[df['body_mass_g'] > 6500, 'body_mass_g'] / 1000.0
    return df

def answer(df):
    df = clean(df)
    df = df.dropna(subset=['island'])
    counts = df.groupby('island')['penguin_id'].count()
    return {str(k): int(v) for k, v in counts.items()}
